programmes.name: Bachelor of Arts
programmes.notes: C$1,717.68/credit x 30 credits (2026/27). Compulsory = UBC Athletics & Recreation fee, AMS fees (excl. opt-out health & dental plan) and U-Pass x 2 terms, plus Arts undergraduate society fees, per the 2026/27 Calendar; iMED insurance excluded.
